search.notes: Search page answered with a captcha page on 2026-10-27, so the pattern is not confirmed.

steps: Open the official privacy notice and follow its published Opt-Out Form link.
Review your own first name, surname, email and the contact authorization; leave optional middle-name and agent fields empty.
Complete the genuine hCaptcha and submit the initial verification form.
Follow the broker email and later matching instructions. Initial submission and email verification are not deletion.
optout.notes: Read-only inspection on November 6 observed the 13-control POST /removal/beginremovalidv form. The subject choice, communications authorization, hidden false fallback, fixed policy links and two genuine hCaptcha fields were checked. No live request or final removal was submitted or verified.
